# Tiferes Final Execution Plan

The Awtsmoos joins ohr and keli, imagination and proof; Awtsmoos.com will share a creative grammar while every specialist studio keeps its roof.

## Files to create
- `geelooy/libs/AwtsmoosUI/`: node normalization, action registry, accessibility, renderer, responsive tokens, default components, public index.
- `geelooy/libs/awtsmoos-procedural-core/src/core/movieAssets/`: semantic seed, normalized recipes, generation receipt, canonical generator, public index.
- `geelooy/apps/awtsmoos-studio/`: mobile-first app shell, AI composer, capability catalog, controller, canvas preview, shared UI descriptor, styles, tests.
- `geelooy/apps/animator/src/scenes/threeMinute/`: 180-second production plan assembled from proven cinematic material plus unified feature declarations.
- `geelooy/apps/animator/tools/render/threeMinute/`: production exporter, paths, proof frames, artifact receipt; tiny entry command.

## Verification
After code: node syntax/import checks, deterministic recipe tests, movie validation tests, preview/browser smoke, 180-second FFmpeg export, ffprobe duration/dimensions/codec, sampled frames, targeted existing Animator/Nesher regression where relevant, complete readback, line/tab checks, and planned-vs-actual closure.
